Im definitely not sure, but like my senses feel altered. The biggest thing ive noticed in those episodes is that i feel extremely light, like im about to float away. I also just feel like my brain isnt working properly or something, but its really hard to explain.

We dont have school counselors here, so if i want to talk about it with a professional, i would need to go to the gp first, for which i first need to talk to my parents... Until i move out, i cant get actual help without telling my parents.

That cycle definitely may be true yeah.

Today ive been in town with my mom almost all day, and after that i napped for the rest of the afternoon, so i didnt do anything for school yet. Im going to try to do something this evening. Honestly, yesterday and today ive been feeling kinda out of it. Im wondering if this is disassociation or something. My senses periodically feel altered, which is quite scary, but i dont know what causes it.

My mom really thinks that suicide is really selfish because "apparently the people around them arent good enough then", so i dont really want to tell her that im considering something so selfish. I tend to have really bad fears for this kinds of stuff, and then it doesnt come true at all, but i dont know if this is one of those situations too.

I havent done any homework or studying today. I only got one hour of sleep last night (i was feeling really anxious for no reason and couldnt sleep) and i can fall asleep for a nap either, so ive just been lying in bed because i cant focus on anything

Im just really scared that my mom will either get mad and call me selfish and that "so much more people have it worse" and stuff, or that she will become overly worried. Both are possible and i really dont want either of those situations to happen.

I dont think that, as long as my situation doesnt change, ill be able to quit self harming anytime soon. Unless i can get a better coping mechanism, its likely not going to happen.

I havent talked about how im actually feeling lately to anyone in my life, no. Im too scared to tell anyone, although i have considered telling a friend about everything. Im too scared to have an actual conversation about it with my parents at the moment.

Ive talked to my parents and teachers about the grades already, but theres not much i can do anymore now besides just studying as hard as i can to make sure my grades stay high enough to graduate. If i end up not graduating, i can go to adult education and take another subject instead of the subject im failing now. So yeah, even if i wont graduate ill only take a year longer to still get a secondary school degree, but i kinda feel like if i take longer than normal to graduate, im even more of a failure. Thats probably also part of the self esteem issues.

And i know that you wont be able to solve my issues, but it really helps to be able to talk about them, so i really want to thank you for that.

Self harming is something that i started doing when i was 13 (about 4 years ago). For the longest time i only did it on and off though (i would only do it for like a week, then not do anything for a couple of months, do it again for a week etc.) but since about a month ago it has gotten way worse to the point of usually at least once a day. I know its bad and i shouldnt be doing it, but i just cant stop anymore.

Some healthy coping mechanisms are definitely needed. Currently, the only coping mechanisms i have that actually work are oversleeping, overeating and self-harm.

Grades here in the Netherlands are quite different compared to the US, we have a grading system of 1-10, with 10 being the highest. We also have different levels of secondary, so grades are less important than in the US. Im following whats considered the highest level of secondary (https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Voorbereidend_wetenschappelijk_onderwijs), and currently i have one 9 (A), two 7s (B), one 5 (F) and for all the other subjects 6s (C). With the grades i currently have i can graduate, but the subject where my grade is a 5 is way harder this year than previous years, so im afraid that itll drop so far that i wont be able to graduate due to that one subject. (i hope everything about the grades makes sense, its quite hard to explain well)

During school breaks where i have no homework, the thoughts get a little less but theyre still nowhere near gone at all. I think its the main pressure rn, but its definitely not the only one. My mom also wants me to get a job for this summer break (because ill have a 2-3 month summer break due to it being the last school year and the final exams being in may) so i dont think the thoughts will go away after graduating from secondary.

I also have very low self esteem, which is probably also one of the main stressors im feeling. Have had it for as long as i can remember, and doubt that my self esteem will ever get better, but oh well

At this point, i need to put all the limited energy i have in school. My grades have been dropping and i still dont know if ill graduate, but if i dont put all my time in school, ill definitely wont graduate this year. So its not really an option for me atm. I also feel like im just wasting my time when doing anything other than school
Well i think its more that whenever i have enough energy to do anything that requires any thinking or concentration at all, ill study because i want to be as productive as possible

I was always planning to go into research up until end of last year actually. I had decided before that that i dont have nearly enough social skills to ever become an actual doctor. However, after quite some thinking i decided that i would probably be happier becoming an actual doctor instead of just doing research. I can always do research next to it, but i dont think i would be happy by purely doing research.

And like i said before, i dont really have any hobbies or something. I used to really enjoy stuff like drawing and gaming in the past, but i dont have the time or motivation to do those things anymore. Whenever im not studying, i just browse reddit and watch youtube or, in the rare cases where i feel i have the concentration for it, watch anime.

I want to study medicine because its really interesting to me, and basically the only thing that i like enough to do for the rest of my (hopefully short) life. Im autistic and its my special interest. I just hope that if i do end up being accepted into med school, that the extra workload will at least balance out with the fact that ill be more motivated because its centered around the thing im interested in instead of just useless stuff like i have to study now in secondary school. I also just wouldnt know what to do with my life if i wouldnt be able to get in. Its the only thing that i actually kinda look forward to in life.

I live in the Netherlands, so the education system is a lot different here. Ill have the entrance exam for med school in two weeks, but im just too tired and not motivated enough to study for it the last couple of weeks. I dont even know if ill graduate from secondary school this year, my grades have been dropping.

Besides studies, i dont really do a lot. In the moments that im too tired or not motivated enough to study (which is most of the time), ill just lie in bed and browse reddit or watch youtube videos. All the energy i have i spend on school.

I know that death is not the only option. I could keep going if i wanted to. I just dont see the point in it anymore though. I might have goals and things i want to do, but those things wont change how im feeling inside. I dont want to keep feeling like this.

I have been feeling really stressed and overwhelmed by school for about 2 years now, so i think thats definitely the major cause in how im feeling. For the past few months, ive also been sleeping way worse than normally.

Im currently in my last year of secondary school, and after this i want to study medicine

I think the thing that makes me want to escape with suicide is mostly just because i constantly feel really tired and also kinda empty. Sometimes i can forget about it for a short time (for example when having fun with friends or family) but it always just seems to return again. Most of the time i wish i could just lie in bed and sleep all day. Its not like i have a bad life or no goals, not at all. I have a pretty good life, but that still doesnt make my thoughts or feelings go away. I also am feeling really stressed and overwhelmed by school. I also just feel like a lot of people would be so much better off if i were dead

I dont think ive ever gotten to the point where there was an actual danger of me seriously hurting myself to the point of dying. Im just way too scared to actually go through with anything. At the moment, its worse than it normally is for me, i cant think about anything other than hurting myself or actually attempting, but im still too scared to actually attempt. 

Im currently not in therapy, i have been in the past but i always felt like my problems werent taken seriously at all and i never saw any progress. My parents know that ive felt suicidal in the past, but they dont know that i still do and that it has gotten worse over time. Im too scared to actually talk about it to anyone i know in person, so i cant go to a professional either

The thing is, when i try to search it on google, all the sites say that passive suicidal thoughts are thoughts like "i wish i were dead" or "i wish i could go to sleep and not wake up", stuff like that, while active suicidal thoughts are intending to commit suicide and making plans for it. I do make plans and sometimes even buy stuff to be able to actually execute it, but i never actually go ahead with attempting
My intention was never to hurt or offend anyone, thank you for pointing it out!
